title: Establish fail-closed disposable browser proof
verify: A tracked tmp/.gitkeep prepares the parent on a fresh checkout; the disposable runner accepts only a project tmp/*.db target, verifies/prepares that parent, removes stale state, and removes the exact database after both successful and failed runs.
Disposable Playwright mode starts its own SvelteKit server with the supplied DATABASE_URL and fails on a port/startup conflict instead of reusing an existing server.
The runner rejects study-calendar.db and paths outside tmp/ before startup, while ordinary npm run e2e keeps its existing real-database behavior.
evidence_required: testing/strategy.md#disposable-browser-proof / REQ-014 / REQ-017 RED: focused E2E can reuse an existing server, accept study-calendar.db, fail on a missing tmp directory, or leave its database after success/failure; GREEN: runner/config tests prove owned-server startup, path rejection/preparation, exact cleanup in both outcomes, and unchanged ordinary real-database mode; artifact: .tasks/TASK-070-T3-FT-007-W29/ and .protocols/TASK-070-T3-FT-007-W29/.
purpose: Provide one reusable fail-closed browser-test boundary for FT-007 without changing the existing real-database smoke.
success_outcome: Every focused FT-007 browser gate can start an owned server on an explicit disposable database and clean it reliably without exposing study-calendar.db.
anti_goals: Do not implement any FT-007 product acceptance criterion.
Do not change the ordinary real-database smoke semantics or credentials path.
Do not delete or reset study-calendar.db or unrelated tmp files.
constraints: The runner interface is node scripts/run-disposable-e2e.mjs --database <tmp/*.db> --spec <spec>.
Disposable mode never falls back to the default database or an existing server.
Cleanup targets only the exact approved disposable database and runs after success and failure.
invariants: study-calendar.db is never opened, modified, or removed by the runner.
A focused gate has one owned server process and one explicit disposable DATABASE_URL.
The normal real-database Playwright command remains compatible.
verification_targets: testing/strategy.md#disposable-browser-proof: accepted/rejected path matrix, owned-server configuration, missing-parent preparation, stale-file removal, and success/failure cleanup.
playwright.config.ts: disposable mode disables reuseExistingServer while ordinary mode preserves current behavior.

stop_conditions: Stop if isolation requires deleting or resetting the real database.
Stop if the runner cannot prove cleanup after both child-process success and failure.
